original_unique_solution: Actual labels put A at the apex and B,C,D,E around the square base. Let common original edge length be s>0. Then AB=AD=s, while BD is the square diagonal s*sqrt2, not one of the eight original edges. Triangle ABD is right isosceles at A, so ABD=45deg uniquely. Equivalently its B cosine is1/sqrt2. The genuine side face ABC is equilateral, giving ABC=60deg; the genuine square-base triangle BCD gives CBD=45deg. However rays BA,BC,BD are not coplanar: with s=1 their scalar triple product has magnitude1/sqrt2. Hence subtracting60-45 is invalid.
